sloka: उपस्थापयितव्याः स्युर्माल्ययोग्याः पृथक् पृथक् ।दीर्घासिबद्धा योधाश्च सन्नद्धा मृष्टवाससः ॥२-३-१९॥
transliteration: upasthāpayitavyāḥ syurmālyayogyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।dīrghāsibaddhā yodhāśca sannaddhā mṛṣṭavāsasaḥ ॥2-3-19॥

translations.english: Let all the warriors in fresh clothes, armed with long swords and fully alert enter the courtyard of the glorious king.
